attack_condition: Material SEND authority change is injected immediately after PRE_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED and before the consequence callable.
seam_exposed_criterion: Changed authority has no SEND standing, yet firewall reports executed and broker consequence reaches the outbox.
seam_not_exposed_criterion: The consequence does not occur after the injected post-validation authority change.
nonclaim: Synthetic deterministic seam injection only; no claim of real-world concurrent revocation propagation.
